{{Quote|Ona Querit. The woman you left on Ylesia? Remember?|Ona Querit|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Ona Querit''', also known as '''The Menace''', was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who lived during the time of the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. She was the daughter of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Querit]] and was seduced to leave [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to live a life of adventure among the galaxy's criminal elements by [[Kaliyo Djannis]]. Her father didn't freeze her account because he believed she was kidnapped. However, Kaliyo left her on [[Ylesia/Legends|Ylesia]], and while on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] she learned to duel. She became the bounty hunter known as the "Menace", and hunted Kaliyo not only for her bounty, but also to show her how strong she became. Kaliyo only knew the Menace was after her and was unaware of Ona's alter ego so she made the bounty hunter a target of [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]].
{{GameDS}}
[[Cipher Nine]] and Kaliyo tracked her down to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and assassinated her.

==Equipment==
Ona Querit had used a red and green set of [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]] equip with blade in her gauntlet. She used an [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] and used weapons equip to her armor that she used against the [[Cipher Nine|Imperial agent]] and [[Kaliyo Djannis]].

==Behind the scenes==
If the agent player chooses a light side option, he/she can avoid violence by persuading Ona to abandon her quest for vengeance and let Kaliyo go.
